title: spec: the kanban lane summary describe says a lookup-lane board's count counts one page; after PR #37327 it counts the whole lane
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (an authored text states behaviour the runtime no longer has) · Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding of the #37074 card thread, PR #37938; seat re-read on `main`)

## What happens

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` says, for a list-view board whose lanes come from a lookup field, that "its `count` counts the page it was handed" (the `KanbanLaneSummarySchema` jsdoc, about :2389-2393) and "its `count` counts that page" (the `summary` describe, about :2520-2521). The #37074 thread reads the console after #36871 and #37327 as computing all five statistics over the whole lane for such a board (`KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`, about :72-81), so an author reading the describe expects a page count where the board shows the lane's.

PR #37938 removes the matching "Known gap" sentence from `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`; the spec text is outside its surface.

## Expected

- [ ] Re-read `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts` and the list view's board hand-off on `main`; if `count` covers the whole lane, the jsdoc and the describe say so (and the generated docs follow); if not, say which board still counts a page.
- [ ] A pin that a lookup-lane board's `count` is the lane's, not the page's.

Grade: area:ux · documentation · reach: one spec describe an author reads in Studio and the docs · evidence: the thread's reading above, not yet re-run by the seat
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: XS
Related: PR #37938, #37074, #36871, PR #37327.
